Among Us color perception survey!

Notice the Among Us character's color shown, and answer the questions that follow!

The more rounds you do, the more helpful and accurate the final analysis will be! When you press Finish, you may adjust some customize colors to look like ones you would like to see in-game!

There are no right or wrong answers, so there’s no need to overthink. I don’t expect anybody to give a perfect, accurate response. And I take this into account when analyzing your responses.

What’s shared?

  • the answers you clicked
  • your color-vision answer, if you choose to give one
  • whether you’re on a phone or computer
  • your screen width
  • the questions you were asked, a random ID that groups your answers together, and the time you started and pressed Submit
  • nothing about your level or score, unless you turn on the optional leaderboard and press its upload button: then your random name, color, and a random leaderboard/session ID are shared.

This is completely voluntary. I will only collect the data necessary for color analysis, which is the sole reason for collecting any anonymous responses.

Answers are anonymous, so no identifying info is shared (like name, email, account, location). I have no way to receive any of this information either. There are no cookies or ads.

Your answers stay on your device until you press Submit. If you press Delete, they’re gone and nothing is sent. When successfully submitted, the anonymous data is stored in a private spreadsheet that only I have access to. When I’m done processing data from all users, I may share the combined processed results online.

If you choose to save your levelling progress, it will be stored on your device. You may delete it at any time.

Feel free to inspect the page in your browser or visit https://github.com/amongussurvey/amongussurvey.github.io.git to see the code.

If you change your mind and want your anonymous data removed, email me at coloringamongus@gmail.com so I can permanently delete all data I received from your end. You will need to provide the approximate time and date (make sure to specify a time-zone) you pressed Submit. You may use this email address to contact me regarding any other questions or concerns.

I’m not affiliated with Innersloth.

Enjoy tossing the crewmates around! Hint: reach the highest level to control the cosmic events in the background yourself!
